summary: A clear DIFC and ADGM focus and a working enquiry form are strong, but unfinished text and no visible phone number appear to cost you high value enquiries.

findings.problem: The regulatory section ends mid sentence with 'the Financial Services', the consultation section starts in lowercase with no subject, and blog posts all carry the same date.
findings.cost: Cut off sentences on a law firm page make clients doubt the care behind the advice.
findings.fix: Finished, proofread copy and real publish dates.

findings.problem: No phone number appears as text. The only number sits inside a WhatsApp link, and several icon links have no label.
findings.cost: Corporate clients who want to call cannot find a number quickly.
findings.fix: A visible click to call number and labelled contact options.

findings.problem: The logo appears to use a blank placeholder image and the legal concepts link goes to the family law page.
findings.cost: A missing logo and wrong links weaken trust at first glance.
findings.fix: A working logo and correct links.

findings.problem: No client testimonials, case results or registration details appear, and only one lawyer is named.
findings.cost: Companies choosing a DIFC firm look for named lawyers and proof.
findings.fix: Named team profiles, credentials and client proof.

redesign: A clear first screen with a visible phone number, WhatsApp and one enquiry form.
Finished copy, a named team and dated, useful articles.
Credentials and client proof placed beside every call to action.
